newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva Power files $250 mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva Power files $250 mln debt shelf.

text.p: Delmarva Power and Light Co filed Thursday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in debt securities and common and preferred stock.
The debt securities may be sold in the form of medium-term notes and first mortgage bonds, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be added to its general funds and used for financing the capital requirements of the company, financing acquisitions of other entities or facilities, refunding or redeeming certain outstanding sercurities and other general corporate purposes.
Delmarva, based in Wilmington, Delaware, is predominantly a public utility that provides electric and natural gas service.
